content.title: About
content.content: Baby Toddler wheels are designed for safe walking adventures for children aged 1 to 4 years. Made from durable yet lightweight plastic, they feature a non‑slip surface and soft rubber pads that protect both the floor and the child from impacts.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The wheels have an adjustable diameter, allowing them to grow with the child.
Each wheel is equipped with a built‑in LED that glows in the dark, increasing visibility.
The design is bolt‑free – all parts are secured with snap‑locks for easy assembly and maintenance.
The plastic complies with European EN71 safety standards for toys.
Two spare rubber pads are included in the package.

items.title: Motor skill development
items.content: Self‑propelled wheels encourage gross motor skills, helping the child learn balance and coordinate movements.

items.title: Sensory perception
items.content: Tactile rubber pads and gentle light effects stimulate touch and visual senses.

items.title: Social interaction
items.content: The wheels are easy to use in parks and playgrounds, promoting group play and interaction with peers.

items.title: Adult supervision required
items.content: Children should use the wheels under constant adult supervision to prevent falls.

items.title: Check fastenings regularly
items.content: Inspect snap‑locks and rubber pads for wear and tighten if necessary.

items.title: Avoid uneven surfaces
items.content: Wheels are intended for smooth, safe areas; rough or slippery surfaces may cause injury.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Attach the wheels to a suitably sized frame, secure the snap‑locks, and test the LEDs. Let the child hold an adult’s hands at first, then gradually allow independent rolling.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the wheels in a dry place away from direct sunlight. For long‑term storage, remove the rubber pads to prevent deformation.

content.title: About
content.content: The salad is made of boiled or roasted chicken or turkey breast, fresh tomatoes, carrots and other vegetables (cucumber, bell pepper, leafy greens). No dressing is added, making it light and low‑calorie.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Chicken and turkey are excellent sources of lean protein.
Tomatoes are rich in lycopene, a powerful antioxidant.
Carrots provide beta‑carotene, a precursor of vitamin A.
The lack of dressing preserves the natural flavors and nutrients of the ingredients.
The salad can be easily adapted for dietary restrictions by swapping the meat for plant‑based alternatives.

items.title: High in protein
items.content: Chicken and turkey supply high‑quality protein needed for muscle growth and tissue repair.

items.title: Low in saturated fat
items.content: Lean poultry contains little saturated fat, supporting heart health.

items.title: Vitamins and minerals
items.content: Tomatoes and carrots provide vitamin C, vitamin K, potassium and iron.

items.title: Antioxidants
items.content: Lycopene and beta‑carotene help combat free radicals, reducing the risk of chronic diseases.

items.title: Digestive support
items.content: Fiber from the vegetables aids bowel regularity and promotes satiety.

items.title: Poultry allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to chicken or turkey.

items.title: Bacterial contamination
items.content: Undercooked meat can harbor Salmonella or Campylobacter.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: If using pre‑seasoned meat, watch the overall sodium intake.

items.title: Pesticide residues
items.content: Thoroughly wash vegetables to reduce pesticide residue exposure.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the salad chilled or at room temperature. It works well in lunch boxes, as a side dish, or a light dinner. If desired, drizzle a small amount of olive oil or lemon juice.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the prepared salad in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 2‑3 days. For longer storage, keep the meat separate from the vegetables to prevent leaf wilting.

coffee-instant-pre-lightened-and-pre-swe.title: Instant Coffee, pre-lightened and pre-sweetened with sugar, reconstituted

content.title: About
content.content: Instant Coffee, pre-lightened and pre-sweetened with sugar, reconstituted (5207) is a ready‑to‑drink product made from roasted coffee beans that undergo extraction, subsequent lightening and sweetening with sugar, then dried into a powder. When hot water is added it dissolves quickly, producing a fragrant beverage.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Instant coffee was first produced commercially in the early 20th century.
Lightening reduces acidity, giving the coffee a milder taste.
Pre‑sweetening with sugar makes the drink ready to consume without extra sweeteners.
This type of coffee is often used in military rations and expedition kits because of its lightweight nature.
Reconstituted indicates that the product already contains all additives needed for a finished drink.

items.title: Quick energy boost
items.content: Caffeine stimulates the central nervous system, increasing alertness and concentration.

items.title: Antioxidants
items.content: Coffee contains polyphenols that help combat free radicals.

items.title: Metabolism support
items.content: Caffeine can slightly raise metabolic rate, aiding calorie burning.

items.title: Digestive aid
items.content: Caffeine promotes gastric secretions, supporting digestion.

items.title: Reduced risk of certain diseases
items.content: Moderate coffee consumption is linked to lower risk of Parkinson’s disease and type‑2 diabetes.

items.title: Caffeine sensitivity
items.content: Some individuals may experience anxiety, insomnia, or rapid heartbeat.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Pre‑sweetened coffee raises the glycemic index and may be unsuitable for diabetics.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: Despite lightening, coffee remains acidic and can irritate the stomach if consumed in excess.

items.title: Coffee allergy
items.content: Rare, but possible allergic reactions to coffee components.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Add 1‑2 teaspoons (≈5‑10 g) of powder to 200 ml of hot (not boiling) water, stir until fully dissolved. Optionally add milk, cream, or spices.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep in a sealed container in a dry, cool place away from direct sunlight. After opening, use within 3‑6 months, ensuring no moisture or off‑smells develop.

content.title: About
content.content: Saltine Multigrain crackers are light, crunchy biscuits made from a blend of wheat, oats, rye and sunflower seeds. They have a mildly salty flavor and a characteristic airy snap. Ideal as a snack on their own or as a base for sandwiches and toppings.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The multigrain formula provides a broader nutrient profile than regular saltine crackers.
Their delicate texture is achieved by double‑baking at a low temperature.
In American cuisine they are often used as “soup crackers” – crumbled into soups for added crunch.
Sunflower seeds give a subtle nutty aroma and increase the content of healthy fats.
A limited edition with added flax and chia was released in the early 2020s.

items.title: High in dietary fiber
items.content: The multigrain blend supplies a good amount of fiber, supporting regular digestion.

items.title: Source of complex carbs
items.content: Crackers provide slow‑releasing energy, helping maintain stable blood‑sugar levels.

items.title: Contains healthy fats
items.content: Sunflower and oat seeds contribute modest amounts of polyunsaturated fats beneficial for heart health.

items.title: Low in sugar
items.content: Unlike sweet biscuits, these crackers contain virtually no added sugar.

items.title: B‑vitamin content
items.content: Wheat and rye offer thiamine, niacin and folate.

items.title: Gluten allergy
items.content: Contains wheat and rye, making them unsuitable for people with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: The salty taste comes from added salt; those limiting sodium should monitor portion size.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: While light, excessive consumption can add up in calories.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy them straight from the pack, spread with cream cheese, hummus or avocado, use as a base for canapés, or crumble into soups for extra crunch.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep in a sealed package in a cool, dry place. After opening, transfer to an airtight container to preserve crispness. Follow the best‑by date on the package.

content.title: About
content.content: Dark chocolate candy with nuts (category — other, NFS) consists of bite‑size pieces of high‑cocoa dark chocolate (≥ 70 % cocoa) blended with a mix of nuts such as almonds, hazelnuts, cashews and others. The candy offers a rich, slightly bitter chocolate flavor complemented by the crunchy texture of the nuts.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Dark chocolate contains more antioxidants than milk chocolate because of its high flavonoid content.
Nuts are often toasted before being added, which intensifies their aroma and crunch.
Consuming dark chocolate can improve mood by boosting serotonin levels.
The chocolate‑nut combination has been used in traditional recipes since ancient Mesoamerican cultures.
In some countries these candies are classified as "confectionery with additives" rather than pure chocolate.

items.title: Rich in antioxidants
items.content: Flavonoids in dark chocolate help neutralize free radicals and protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Provides healthy fats
items.content: Nuts supply monounsaturated and polyunsaturated fatty acids that support heart health.

items.title: Source of minerals
items.content: The product contains magnesium, iron, zinc and copper, essential for metabolic processes.

items.title: Supports cognitive function
items.content: The combination of flavonoids and vitamin E from nuts may enhance memory and concentration.

items.title: Stress‑relief effect
items.content: Dark chocolate stimulates endorphin release, contributing to a better mood.

items.title: Nut allergy
items.content: The candy contains various nuts; individuals with nut allergies may experience severe reactions.

items.title: High calorie density
items.content: Both dark chocolate and nuts are energy‑dense, so portion control is important for weight management.

items.title: Caffeine and theobromine content
items.content: Dark chocolate contains stimulants that can affect sleep and increase anxiety in sensitive people.

items.title: Added sugar
items.content: Some versions may contain added sugar, which should be considered by people with diabetes.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy the candy as a snack, stir into yogurt or muesli, or use in baking to add a chocolate‑nut flavor. Gently warming the pieces can soften the chocolate for easier melting.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep in an airtight package in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. For longer shelf life store in the refrigerator to prevent chocolate bloom. Keep away from strong odors.

content.title: About
content.content: A prepackaged vanilla ice cream cone is a convenient dessert ready to eat. Inside the crisp waffle cone lies smooth, creamy vanilla ice cream with a natural vanilla flavor, finished with a thin crunchy shell.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Vanilla is one of the most popular ice cream flavors worldwide.
The waffle cone was invented in the early 1900s in the United States as a handy way to serve ice cream.
Prepackaged cones often contain a small amount of air to prevent deformation during transport.
There are over 30 flavor variations for ice cream cones, but vanilla remains a classic.

items.title: Source of calcium
items.content: The dairy base of the ice cream provides calcium, essential for bone health.

items.title: Vitamin D
items.content: Vitamin D present in dairy helps with calcium absorption.

items.title: Quick energy
items.content: Ice cream supplies fast‑acting carbohydrates and a modest amount of fat for quick energy.

items.title: High sugar content
items.content: Large amounts of sugar can contribute to weight gain and raise blood glucose levels.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: Ice cream contains lactose, which may cause discomfort for those who are lactose intolerant.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to casein or whey proteins.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The cone can be eaten straight from the package. For extra flavor, add toppings such as chocolate sauce, nuts, berries, or sprinkle with cookie crumbs.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a freezer at –18 °C (0 °F) or lower. Once opened, consume within 1–2 days to avoid ice crystal formation and texture loss.

infant-formula-store-brand-advantage-or-.title: Infant Formula, Store Brand, Tender Advantage, Powder, Made with Bottled Water

content.title: About
content.content: Tender infant formula is a nutritionally complete powder designed for babies from birth to 12 months. The formula is based on bottled water, providing a consistent mineral profile and freedom from contaminants. It supplies essential proteins, fats, carbohydrates, vitamins, and minerals to support healthy growth and development.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The product is manufactured under strict quality controls meeting ISO 22000 standards.
The bottled water used undergoes triple filtration and microbiological testing.
Tender was developed according to WHO guidelines and national pediatric recommendations.
The powder dissolves easily in warm water, creating a smooth, lump‑free feed.
Each package contains 360 servings, convenient for long‑term use.

items.title: Supports growth and development
items.content: Balanced ratios of protein, fat, and carbohydrate provide the building blocks for rapid tissue and brain development.

items.title: Rich vitamin complex
items.content: Includes vitamins A, D, E, K and B‑complex, which aid vision, immunity, and metabolism.

items.title: Mineral balance
items.content: Calcium, phosphorus and magnesium promote strong bones and teeth.

items.title: Easy digestion
items.content: A special protein processing technology reduces allergenicity and eases gastrointestinal tolerance.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Prebiotics and omega‑3 fatty acids help strengthen the infant’s immune system.

items.title: Cow‑milk protein allergy
items.content: Infants with confirmed cow‑milk allergy should use a hypoallergenic formula.

items.title: Improper reconstitution
items.content: Over‑concentrated or overly diluted feeds can lead to dehydration or over‑feeding.

items.title: Shelf‑life after opening
items.content: Once opened, use the formula within 30 days and keep it in a dry place.

items.title: Temperature limits
items.content: Do not use water hotter than 40 °C, as high heat can degrade sensitive vitamins.

content.title: How to Prepare
content.content: Measure the recommended amount of powder (usually one level scoop) and add it to warm bottled water (36–40 °C). Stir thoroughly until fully dissolved, avoiding lumps. If needed, warm the mixture to a comfortable body temperature before feeding.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the container in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep the lid tightly sealed. Do not refrigerate, as moisture can cause clumping.
